1170-1418-4124-5954-8345.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

3968-4050-4078-6578.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-6578.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Sephiroth triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

141-653-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-653-4050.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1808-2837-3899.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2837-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

206-339-677-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

824-2728-6012-6798.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-6012-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-6012-6798.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4068-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-4068-7752.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4068-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

339-677-2034-4742.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4809-5220-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Warhost's Frenzy.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shifting Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Shifting Wall from your library.
Repeat from step 2

2661-3692-6967.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

431-3129-4365-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-3129-4365-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2034-4593-6291-6823.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mites enter the battlefield, Aunt May triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4593-6291-6823.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mites.

53-2228-4279.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
53-2228-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra and Obelisk Spider's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Hapatra trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
Resolve the Obelisk Spider trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
53-2228-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

81-4120-4968.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
81-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
81-4120-4968.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2921-5276-6412.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

542-4377-6333.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{B} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
542-4377-6333.notablePrerequisites: You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
542-4377-6333.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Hades from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Emet-Selch by paying {1}{U}{B}.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

277-4772-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
277-4772-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-4772-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Resolve both Tiller Engine triggers, untapping both Everywhere tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.

428-804-3090-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-804-3090-5096.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima the Impostor trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

1409-2895-3147-4826.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3147-4826.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters untapped due to Archelos, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.
